Mode for ending a debug session.

detaileddescription.para:
Cross-platform intent. Choose based on target state:
terminate: target is alive, kill it on detach
detach: target is alive, leave it running
passive: target has already exited; release session state only
Windows maps this directly to a dbgeng DEBUG_END_* flag passed to IDebugClient5::EndSession.

launch or attach request sent; the first stop has not arrived yet.
Target is executing. Resume/step have been issued.
Target is paused at a breakpoint, step completion, or exception.
Target process has exited.
Coarse execution state of the debug target, stored in the executionState parameter.

detaileddescription.para: The engine context writes the state. Processor::process reads it to decide whether to poll the engine.

briefdescription.para: Cause of the current stop, stored in the stopReason parameter.

detaileddescription.para: StopManager::onStop reads stopReason and runs the drain for that value. The drains set it back to none when they run. drainInitialBreak does so only after configurationDone is set.

Writers, by value:
none: The default, and the value that the drains store.
initialBreak: Callbacks.cpp onBreakpoint while launching; Session_mac onProcessStateStopped while launching; Processor::setAttachedState on macOS.
moduleLoad: Callbacks.cpp LoadModule, when no step is pending.
breakpoint: Callbacks.cpp Breakpoint; Session_mac onBreakpointStop.
step: Session::pollEvents on Windows, and Session_mac onStepStop. StopManager stores it only when stopReason is none.
pause: Callbacks.cpp onBreakpoint while isPausePending; Session_mac onInterruptStop.
exception: Callbacks.cpp onBreakpoint and onUnknownException (second chance); Session_mac onSignalStop and onExceptionStop.

briefdescription.para: Return true if a symbol/variable name should be hidden from the DAP variable panel.

detaileddescription.para: Hides the names that start with "<", "__vfptr", or "leakDetector", and the name juce::compileUnitMismatchSentinel. These are compiler-injected or JUCE-injected symbols with no user-visible meaning.

parameterdescription.para: Symbol or variable name as reported by the debug engine.

simplesect.para: true if the symbol should be skipped.

briefdescription.para: Extract a hexadecimal address from a debug engine value text string.

detaileddescription.para: Removes backtick digit-group padding (dbgeng's 64-bit address formatting), trims the text, and, when the text starts with "0x", parses the token up to the first space as a 64-bit unsigned integer. Used to extract pointer values from formatted symbol text such as "0x0000000010db01b0 \"hello\"".

parameterdescription.para: Symbol value text that may start with a hex address.

simplesect.para: Parsed address, or 0 if the text does not start with "0x".

simplesect.para: Formatted display string, or empty if the type is not recognized.

briefdescription.para: Translate a platform-native exception or signal code to a name.

detaileddescription.para: Windows: code is an NTSTATUS or SEH exception code, for example 0xC0000005 gives ACCESS_VIOLATION. isMachException is ignored. macOS: code is a POSIX signal number when isMachException is false, or a Mach exception type when it is true. Signal 11 gives EXC_BAD_ACCESS when isMachException is false. Mach exception type 1 gives EXC_BAD_ACCESS when it is true.

Implementations live in platform-specific files: Callbacks.cpp on Windows, Session_mac.cpp on macOS. Called by StopManager::drainExceptionStopped and Processor::onExceptionInfo to build the DAP exceptionId field.

parameterdescription.para: Platform-native exception or signal code, from Id::exceptionCode.
Value of Id::isMachException. Selects the Mach table on macOS.

simplesect.para: The name, or a fallback of the form 0x<hex> when the code is not in the table.
